<!-- Listing or updating a plug-in: only add or change plugins/<slug>.toml. CI comments what it
     found and merges on its own when the rules in CONTRIBUTING.md hold. -->

**What this lists or changes:**

- [ ] The plug-in is mine to list (I own its repository or published its release), or I say below why a maintainer should list it.
- [ ] Its manifest's description and permissions match what it does.
